digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: GitHub Actions runner pool saturation during Gerrit Verified dispatch bursts is caused by high job fan-out per patchset (up to 24 jobs), not by tickets-branch pushes

Observed incident-period peak showed 22 waiting jobs and 873s maximum runner wait; current shape shows 22 waiting jobs with 197s maximum wait, indicating persistent queueing under independent-change bursts
Free plan organization-level concurrency limit of 20 total and 5 macOS jobs constrains simultaneous run capacity while per-run job count reaches 24 with mutations

Four mutually exclusive remediation options exist with measurable trade-offs: bundle preflights with mutation cap (option A, recommended), coalesce superseded patchsets (option B, low value), move macOS to scheduled health (option C, weakens coverage), or upgrade organization plan (option D, adds recurring cost)
